tool.name: Biomni: Perform Facs Cell Sorting
tool.description: Performs Fluorescence-Activated Cell Sorting (FACS) to enrich cell populations based on fluorescence characteristics.
tool.command:
python -c " import sys import json from biomni.tool.cell_biology import perform_facs_cell_sorting
# Parse arguments args = {} i = 1 while i < len(sys.argv): if sys.argv[i].startswith('--'): key = sys.argv[i][2:] if i + 1 < len(sys.argv) and not sys.argv[i + 1].startswith('--'): val = sys.argv[i + 1] # Type conversion if val.lower() == 'true': val = True elif val.lower() == 'false': val = False else: try: val = int(val) except: try: val = float(val) except: pass args[key] = val i += 2 else: args[key] = True i += 1 else: i += 1
# Call function result = perform_facs_cell_sorting(**args)
# Write output output_path = args.get('output', '/dev/stdout') with open(output_path, 'w') as f: if isinstance(result, str): f.write(result) elif isinstance(result, (dict, list)): json.dump(result, f, indent=2, default=str) else: f.write(str(result)) " --output '$output' --cell_suspension_data '$cell_suspension_data' --fluorescence_parameter '$fluorescence_parameter' #if $threshold_min --threshold_min '$threshold_min' #end if #if $threshold_max --threshold_max '$threshold_max' #end if #if $output_file --output_file '$output_file' #end if

param.name: cell_suspension_data
param.label: Cell Suspension Data
param.help: Path to the FCS file containing flow cytometry data

param.name: fluorescence_parameter
param.label: Fluorescence Parameter
param.help: The fluorescence parameter to use for sorting (e.g., 'GFP', 'FITC', 'PE')

param.name: threshold_min
param.label: Threshold Min
param.help: Minimum threshold for the fluorescence parameter. Cells below this value will be excluded

param.name: threshold_max
param.label: Threshold Max
param.help: Maximum threshold for the fluorescence parameter. Cells above this value will be excluded

param.name: output_file
param.label: Output File
param.help: Filename to save the sorted cell population data

tool.help:
**Biomni: Perform Facs Cell Sorting**
Performs Fluorescence-Activated Cell Sorting (FACS) to enrich cell populations based on fluorescence characteristics.
Parameters ---------- cell_suspension_data : str Path to the FCS file containing flow cytometry data fluorescence_parameter : str The fluorescence parameter to use for sorting (e.g., 'GFP', 'FITC', 'PE') threshold_min : float, optional Minimum threshold for the fluorescence parameter. Cells below this value will be excluded threshold_max : float, optional Maximum threshold for the fluorescence parameter. Cells above this value will be excluded output_file : str, optional Filename to save the sorted cell population data
Returns ------- str Research log detailing the FACS cell sorting process
**Domain**: cell_biology **Function**: perform_facs_cell_sorting
